description: A fill companion node that generated an UV map that follows each filled area

inputs.description: The input fill data, to be connected to the output of a Fill node
inputs.name: in

name: Fill to UV

outputs.description: The generated output UV map, to be connected to a Custom UV node
outputs.label: Output

parameters.description:
The mode decides how the UVs are layed out on each bounding box:
- Stretch mode where the UV layout is stretched to the bounding box. 
- Square mode where the UV layout is even and centerered based on the longest axis of the bounding box.
parameters.name: mode
